headline: Eight decision-truth improvements shipped; capability, evidence, delivery, and model language now fail closed as compound receipts.

items.title: Subtractive capability and independent quote evidence
items.insight: Remote configuration cannot create capability, while +EV requires fresh target-excluded no-vig evidence from distinct sources.
items.evidence: 11 flag checks; 5 quote-evidence checks; five consumers ratcheted.

items.title: Persistence-aware gifts and evidence-labeled decision language
items.insight: Gift success is decomposed by authority, and behavioral/model signals no longer imply skill or action quality.
items.evidence: 4 referral checks; 6 tool/model checks; 52 Edge tests.

items.title: Cross-surface claim ratchet and rendered proof
items.insight: Repaired claims are mechanically rejected and every touched decision state is hash-bound across themes and viewports.
items.evidence: 334 files × 30 rules; 24/24 captures; 12/12 theme pairs; launch-local exit 0.

honestyLedger.title: No capability fabrication
honestyLedger.why: The production-default false build ceiling wins over remote rows.

honestyLedger.title: No delivery or performance overclaim
honestyLedger.why: Acceptance, delivery, persistence, tool use, and model quality remain separate evidence classes.

honestyLedger.title: No visual or launch fabrication
honestyLedger.why: Objective pixels pass; semantic viewing and external launch criteria remain explicit gaps.

followUps: Establish stable staging plus all six response headers.
Obtain exact target-bound Supabase authority before applying pending migrations/functions.
Prove remaining Zoho, Obelisk, auth, Stripe, friend, capture, remediation, and founder criteria.
blockers: External release evidence remains incomplete; repository development and local verification are green.
Semantic image return is unavailable because Windows DPAPI initialization fails; objective rendered evidence passes.
